sections.heading: HOW THIS SCHEME WAS PREPARED
sections.body: Derived from the curriculum design. Official strands and sub-strands remain the reference anchors; lesson-specific focuses and teaching steps are deduced from the content, not additional official KICD sub-strands. Review and adapt to your class before use.
items: Quality pass: 23 key inquiry question(s) made lesson-specific where the source repeated one question across a sub-strand.
Harvested KICD curriculum design for Grade 7 Creative Arts (23 sub-strands)
Term 3 covers 4 sub-strand(s), weighted by KICD's own lesson allocations
Kenya school calendar: Term 3 has 9 weeks at 4 lessons/week
Solis scheme builder format v7; lesson focuses are deduced from outcomes and activities, with staged practice instead of repeated headings
Resource/assessment-only duplicate rows with already defined strand/unit codes were omitted; they are not additional teaching units.
